name: draft-pr
description: Draft evidence-backed pull request titles and descriptions after verifying the intended comparison.

interface.shortDescription: Draft PR copy from verified repository evidence
interface.longDescription: Verify the intended source and target, inspect the pull request comparison, and draft a concise title and body grounded in repository evidence. This skill prepares copy without publishing a pull request.
defaultPrompt: Use $draft-pr:draft-pr to verify the intended PR comparison and draft a reviewer-ready title and body from repository evidence.
